new.title: One fan-in-two AND/OR/NOT circuit extracts an irredundant equivalent cyclic table and witnesses each retained blocking clause
new.statement:
∀ (n w : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n),
  let T := n * 2 ^ (w + 1)
  let I := T + n + (w + 1)
  let pos := fun (start : Fin n) (offset : Fin (w + 1)) =>
    (⟨(start.val + offset.val) % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩ : Fin n)
  let window := fun (word : Fin n → Bool) (row : Fin n) (k : Fin (w + 1)) =>
    word (pos row k)
  let clauses := fun (mask : Fin n → (Fin (w + 1) → Bool) → Bool) =>
    ({D | ∃ (r : Fin n) (p : Fin (w + 1) → Bool), mask r p = false ∧
      D = Finset.univ.image (fun b : Fin (w + 1) => (pos r b, !(p b)))} :
      Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Fin n)))
  ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit)
    (allowWire : Fin n → (Fin (w + 1) → Bool) → ℕ) (wordWire : Fin n → ℕ),
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack I C ∧
    C.size ≤ 64 * (n + 1) * 4 ^ w ∧ C.output < I + C.size ∧
    (∀ i q, allowWire i q < I + C.size) ∧ (∀ j, wordWire j < I + C.size) ∧
    ∀ table : Fin n → (Fin (w + 1) → Bool) → Bool,
      ∃ reduced : Fin n → (Fin (w + 1) → Bool) → Bool,
        (∀ i q, table i q = true → reduced i q = true) ∧
        (∀ x : Fin n → Bool, (∀ i, table i (window x i) = true) ↔
          ∀ i, reduced i (window x i) = true) ∧
        (∀ D ∈ clauses reduced, ∃ a : Fin n → Bool,
          ¬ PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.ClauseSat a D ∧
          PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Satisfies a (clauses reduced \ {D})) ∧
        ∀ (queryRow : Fin n) (queryPat : Fin (w + 1) → Bool),
          let inputs := List.ofFn (fun addr : Fin T =>
            table ⟨(addr.val / 2 ^ (w + 1)) % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩
              (fun digit => addr.val.testBit digit.val)) ++
            List.ofFn (fun rowBit : Fin n => decide (rowBit = queryRow)) ++
            List.ofFn queryPat
          let bit := fun wire : ℕ => (C.wires inputs).getD wire false
          let answer := fun index : Fin n => bit (wordWire index)
          (∀ i q, bit (allowWire i q) = reduced i q) ∧
          (C.eval inputs = true ↔ PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Satisfiable (clauses table)) ∧
          (reduced queryRow queryPat = false → window answer queryRow = queryPat ∧
            ∀ j : Fin n, j ≠ queryRow → reduced j (window answer j) = true)

new.statement:

      lit.1.val = (start.val + offset.val) % n) →

new.title: A ternary CNF propagates every forced word and table literal under partial assignments to cyclic window constraints
new.statement:
∀ (n w : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n),
  let V := Sum (Fin n) (Fin n × (Fin (w + 1) → Bool))
  let accepts := fun (a : V → Bool) =>
    ∀ i : Fin n, a (Sum.inr (i, fun j : Fin (w + 1) =>
      a (Sum.inl ⟨(i.val + j.val) % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩))) = true
  ∃ (m : ℕ) (F : Finset (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Sum V (Fin m)))),
    m + (∑ D ∈ F, D.card) ≤ 128 * (n + 1) * 4 ^ w ∧
    (∀ D ∈ F, D.card ≤ 3) ∧
    (∀ a : V → Bool, accepts a ↔ ∃ aux : Fin m → Bool,
      PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Satisfies (Sum.elim a aux) (↑F : Set _)) ∧
    ∀ ρ : V → Option Bool,
      let assumptions : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Literal (Sum V (Fin m))) :=
        {l | ∃ v : V, l.1 = Sum.inl v ∧ ρ v = some l.2}
      let completion := fun (a : V → Bool) =>
        accepts a ∧ ∀ (v : V) (b : Bool), ρ v = some b → a v = b

        ∃ D ∈ F, ∀ l ∈ D, PEqualNP.Search.UPForces (↑F : Set _) assumptions

new.title: Minimal inconsistent partial assignments characterize the parallel unit propagation depth of width-three CNF encodings
new.statement:
∀ (n d : ℕ), 0 < d → ∀ R : Finset (Fin n → Bool),
  let Pin := PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Literal (Fin n)
  let fits := fun (pins : Finset Pin) (a : Fin n → Bool) =>
    ∀ l ∈ pins, a l.1 = l.2
  let isCore := fun (candidate : Finset Pin) =>
    (∃ a, fits candidate a) ∧ (¬ ∃ a ∈ R, fits candidate a) ∧
      ∀ e ∈ candidate, ∃ a ∈ R, fits (candidate.erase e) a
  let cores := @Finset.filter (Finset Pin) isCore (Classical.decPred isCore) Finset.univ
  let small := ∀ P ∈ cores, P.card ≤ 2 ^ d + 1
  let enc := fun (m : ℕ)
      (F : Finset (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Sum (Fin n) (Fin m)))) =>
    let step := fun S : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Literal (Sum (Fin n) (Fin m))) =>
      S ∪ {l | ∃ D ∈ F, l ∈ D ∧ ∀ other ∈ D, other ≠ l →
        PEqualNP.Search.negLit other ∈ S}
    (∀ D ∈ F, D.card ≤ 3) ∧
    (∀ a : Fin n → Bool, a ∈ R ↔ ∃ aux : Fin m → Bool,
      PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Satisfies (Sum.elim a aux) (↑F : Set _)) ∧
    ∀ P : Finset Pin, (∃ a, fits P a) →
      let seed : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Literal (Sum (Fin n) (Fin m))) :=
        {l | ∃ e ∈ P, l = (Sum.inl e.1, e.2)}
      let known := (step^[d]) seed
      ((¬ ∃ a ∈ R, fits P a) ↔
        ∃ D ∈ F, ∀ l ∈ D, PEqualNP.Search.negLit l ∈ known) ∧
      ((∃ a ∈ R, fits P a) → ∀ v : Fin n, ∀ b : Bool,
        (∀ a ∈ R, fits P a → a v = b) ↔ (Sum.inl v, b) ∈ known)
  ((∃ m F, enc m F) → small) ∧
    (small → ∃ m F, enc m F ∧
      m + (∑ D ∈ F, D.card) ≤ 4 * d * (∑ P ∈ cores, P.card))

new.title: When a cyclic window omits one bit, the maximum size of a minimal conflict equals cube size minus the minimum radius-one covering code size
new.statement:
∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n), 2 ≤ n →
  let Word := Fin n → Bool
  let Pat := Fin (n - 1) → Bool
  let V := Sum (Fin n) (Fin n × Pat)
  let Pin := PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Literal V
  let accepts := fun (a : V → Bool) =>
    ∀ i : Fin n, a (Sum.inr (i, fun j : Fin (n - 1) =>
      a (Sum.inl ⟨(i.val + j.val) % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩))) = true
  let fits := fun (pins : Finset Pin) (a : V → Bool) => ∀ l ∈ pins, a l.1 = l.2
  let core := fun (candidate : Finset Pin) =>
    (∃ a, fits candidate a) ∧ (¬ ∃ a, accepts a ∧ fits candidate a) ∧
    ∀ e ∈ candidate, ∃ a, accepts a ∧ fits (candidate.erase e) a
  let covers := fun (centers : Finset Word) =>
    ∀ x : Word, ∃ c ∈ centers, (Finset.univ.filter (fun k : Fin n => x k ≠ c k)).card ≤ 1
  ∃ (P : Finset Pin) (S : Finset Word),
    core P ∧ (∀ l ∈ P, ∃ i : Fin n, ∃ p : Pat, l = (Sum.inr (i, p), false)) ∧
    (∀ Q, core Q → Q.card ≤ P.card) ∧ covers S ∧
    (∀ T, covers T → S.card ≤ T.card) ∧ P.card + S.card = 2 ^ n ∧
    (3 ≤ n → 3 * 2 ^ n ≤ 4 * P.card) ∧
    ((∃ r : ℕ, n + 1 = 2 ^ r) → (n + 1) * P.card = n * 2 ^ n)

new.title: A signed product recovers the count of names realizing any prescribed key history at each fixed schedule
new.statement:
∀ (k r s : Nat) (hk : 0 < k),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let W := Fin k → F
  let ix := fun t : Nat => (⟨t%k, Nat.mod_lt _ hk⟩ : Fin k)
  let rot := fun (amount : Nat) (x : W) (j : Fin k) => x (ix (j.val+k-amount%k))
  let layer := fun (gap : Nat) (x : W) =>
    let m := fun (j : Fin k) => x j + x (ix (j.val+gap)) + x (ix (j.val+k-gap%k))
    fun (j : Fin k) => m j + (1+m (ix (j.val+1))) * m (ix (j.val+2))
  ∀ (col : Bool) (raw : W) (delta : Fin s → W)
    (path : Fin (r+1) → Fin s → W) (test : Finset (Fin k)) (target : W),
    let initial := if col then 3 else 1
    let gap := if col then 2 else 1
    let inject := fun t : Nat => if col then 3*(t+1)+1 else 2*t
    let state := fun (data : W × (Fin r → W)) (key : W) (time : Fin (r+1)) =>
      ((List.finRange r).take time.val).foldl (fun v tick =>
        layer gap v + rot (inject tick.val) key + data.2 tick) (rot initial key + data.1)
    let S := Fin r → W
    let valid := ∀ p, path 0 p = rot initial (delta p)
    let localSet := fun (t : Fin r) => (Finset.univ : Finset W).filter (fun v => ∀ p : Fin s,
      layer gap (v+path t.castSucc p) - layer gap v + rot (inject t.val) (delta p) = path t.succ p)
    let hits := fun (c : S) => ((Finset.univ : Finset W).filter (fun name =>
      (∀ t p, state (name,c) (raw+delta p) t - state (name,c) raw t = path t p) ∧
      (∀ j ∈ test, state (name,c) raw (Fin.last r) j = target j))).card
    let prev := fun (b : S) (j : Nat) => ∑ t : Fin r, (if t.val+1 = j then b t else 0)
    let pairing := fun (b c : S) => ∑ t : Fin r, dotProduct (b t) (c t)
    let phase := fun (b : S) (t : Fin r) (v : W) => dotProduct (prev b t.val) v +
      dotProduct (b t) (layer gap v + rot (inject t.val) raw)
    let sign := fun f : F => if f = 0 then (1 : ℤ) else -1
    let score := fun b : S =>
      if valid ∧ (∀ j : Fin k, j ∉ test → prev b r j = 0) then
        (2 : ℤ)^(k-test.card) * sign (dotProduct (prev b r) target) *
          (∏ t : Fin r, (∑ v ∈ localSet t, sign (phase b t v)))
      else 0
    (∀ b : S, (∑ c : S, (hits c : ℤ) * sign (pairing b c)) = score b) ∧
    (∀ c : S, (2 : ℤ)^(k*r) * (hits c : ℤ) = ∑ b : S, score b * sign (pairing b c))

      (∀ t p, state (name,c) (raw+delta p) t - state (name,c) raw t = path t p) ∧
      (∀ j ∈ test, state (name,c) raw (Fin.last r) j = target j))).card
    let prev := fun (b : S) (j : Nat) => ∑ t : Fin r, (if t.val+1 = j then b t else 0)
    let pairing := fun (b c : S) => ∑ t : Fin r, dotProduct (b t) (c t)
    let phase := fun (b : S) (t : Fin r) (v : W) => dotProduct (prev b t.val) v +

    let supp := (Finset.univ : Finset S).filter (fun b => 0 < energy b)
    ∀ q : Nat,
      (∀ Q : S →ₗ[F] (Fin q → F),
        let visible := fun b : S => ∀ z : S, Q z = 0 → pairing b z = 0
        let lost : ℚ := ∑ b ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset S).filter (fun m => ¬visible m), (energy b : ℚ)
        let err := fun (dec : (Fin q → F) → ℚ) =>

  let F := ZMod 2

changed.title: Disjoint perfect matchings on the actual cyclic name graph account for every common-key multiplicity
changed.statement:
∀ (k : ℕ) [NeZero k] (h r : ℕ),
  let span := if r = 1 then 7 else 7*r-2

  let I := ZMod k
  let W := I → ZMod 2
  let lo := k-h

  let mix := fun (dist : ℕ) (word : W) (site : I) =>

  let chi := fun (word : W) (site : I) =>
    word site + (1 + word (site+1)) * word (site+2)

    let rowTest := fun (u key : W) =>
      let out := (List.range r).foldl (fun acc t =>

  ∀ (start : ℕ) (feed : ℕ → ℕ) (c : ℕ → W) (shift : Fin s → W),

      let B := (Finset.univ : Finset W).filter (fun y => ∀ p,

          passes name w ∧ ∀ p, delta name w 3 p = want p)).card : ℤ) =
          ∑ nm : W, ∑ m : Fin s → W,

changed.title: A ternary matrix at every order retains the Hadamard determinant-to-permanent ratio up to an explicit factor
changed.statement:
∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n →
  let I := Fin n
  let P := fun H : Matrix I I ℝ => Matrix.permanent (fun i j => (H i j)^2)
  let penalty := (n+1)^(Nat.log2 n+1)
  ∃ H : Matrix I I ℝ,
    (∀ i j, H i j = -1 ∨ H i j = 0 ∨ H i j = 1) ∧ 0 < P H ∧
    (n : ℝ)^n * P H ≤ (penalty : ℝ) * (n.factorial : ℝ) * H.det^2 ∧
    (∀ h : ℕ, n = 2^h → (n : ℝ)^n * P H = (n.factorial : ℝ) * H.det^2)
changed.unlocks: Provides high-ratio ternary witnesses in every dimension and exact witnesses at powers of two.
changed.context: Split n into its distinct powers of two and take the corresponding block diagonal Sylvester matrices. A block of size d contributes d^d/d!. changed.title: XOR shifts attain the minimum number of selector edits needed to separate switched profiles and characterize equality within each address
changed.statement:
∀ k a : ℕ, (0 < a ∧ 2^a ≤ k ∧ 4 ≤ 2^k / 2^a) →
  let N := 2^k
  let r := 2^a
  let I := Fin N
  let F := fun x y : I => x.val.testBit (y.val % r)
  ∀ D : Finset ℕ, D ⊆ Finset.range r → 4*D.card ≤ N/r →
    let G := fun x y : I => xor (F x y) (decide (Nat.xor x.val y.val ∈ D))
    PEqualNP.Represents.HasLitSize (k+k) (PEqualNP.Represents.adjFun (k := k) (l := k) G)
      (8*k+12*r+12) ∧
    (∀ i : I, (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : I => G i j ≠ F i j)).card = D.card ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : I => G j i ≠ F j i)).card = D.card) ∧
    (∀ f g : I → Bool,
      let T := fun x y : I => xor (G x y) (xor (f x) (g y))
      ∀ i j : I, i ≠ j →
        2*D.card ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun z : I => T i z ≠ T j z)).card ∧
        2*D.card ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun z : I => T z i ≠ T z j)).card) ∧
    ∀ (s : ℕ) (H : I → I → Bool),
      (∀ i j : I, i ≠ j → i.val % r = j.val % r →
        2*s ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : I => H x i ≠ H x j)).card) →
      let w := (Finset.univ.filter (fun z : I × I => H z.1 z.2 ≠ F z.1 z.2)).card
      N*s ≤ w ∧ (w = N*s →
        s ≤ r ∧ (∀ j : I, (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : I => H x j ≠ F x j)).card = s) ∧
        ∀ x i j : I, i ≠ j → i.val % r = j.val % r → H x i ≠ F x i → H x j = F x j)

changed.context: Intersecting edit sets force the names to differ only in low address bits. Their selected row words are then neither equal nor complementary. changed.title: The density of selector edits inside squares bounds the gate deficit for arbitrary one-hot circuits
changed.statement:
∀ k a : ℕ, (0 < a ∧ 2^a ≤ k) →
  let N := 2^k
  let r := 2^a
  let I := Fin N
  ∀ (T : I → I → Bool) (f g : I → Bool) (A B : Finset I) (q u v : ℕ),
    let F := fun x y : I => xor (x.val.testBit (y.val % r)) (xor (f x) (g y))
    0 < v →
    (∀ i j : I, i ≠ j →
      17+2*(v-1) ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun z : I => T i z ≠ T j z)).card ∧
      17+2*(v-1) ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun z : I => T z i ≠ T z j)).card) →
    (∀ X Y : Finset I, Disjoint X A → Disjoint Y B → X.card = Y.card →
      ((X ×ˢ Y).filter (fun z => T z.1 z.2 ≠ F z.1 z.2)).card ≤ q*X.card+u) →
    ∀ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, (∀ gate ∈ C.gates, gate.inputs.length ≤ 2) →
      let e := (Finset.univ.filter (fun z : I × I =>
        C.eval (PEqualNP.Represents.oneEach z.1 z.2) ≠ T z.1 z.2)).card
      let b := C.gates.countP (fun gate => gate.inputs.length == 2)
      (32*N-(15*b+54+44*(e/v)+A.card+B.card+4*q+2*a*(N/r)))^2 ≤ 4*(e+u)

changed.statement:
∀ k a : ℕ, (6 ≤ a ∧ 2*2^a ≤ k) →
  let N := 2^k
  let r := 2^a
  let I := Fin N
  ∀ f g : I → Bool,

      (∀ gate ∈ C.gates, gate.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧
        16*(C.gates.countP (fun gate => gate.inputs.length == 2)) ≤ 33*N
    let loss := fun (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (D : Finset ℕ) =>
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun z : I × I =>
        C.eval (PEqualNP.Represents.oneEach z.1 z.2) ≠
          xor (xor (z.1.val.testBit (z.2.val % r)) (decide (Nat.xor z.1.val z.2.val ∈ D)))
            (xor (f z.1) (g z.2)))).card
    ∃ C₀, fits C₀ ∧ ∀ D : Finset ℕ, D ⊆ Finset.range r →
      loss C₀ D = N*D.card ∧ (16 ≤ D.card →
        ∀ C, fits C → N*D.card < 128*loss C D)

changed.title: Known result rebuilt: Huffman optimality with any designated pair of least-weight symbols as deepest siblings
changed.statement:
∀ (m : ℕ) (w : Fin m → ℕ) (a b : Fin m), a ≠ b →
  (∀ i, 0 < w i) → (∀ i, i ≠ a → i ≠ b → w a ≤ w i ∧ w b ≤ w i) →
  let prefixCode := fun (code : Fin m → List Bool) =>
    ∀ i j, (∃ tail : List Bool, code j = code i ++ tail) → i = j
  let cost := fun (c : Fin m → List Bool) => ∑ i, w i * (c i).length
  ∃ (c : Fin m → List Bool) (parent : List Bool), prefixCode c ∧
    c a = parent ++ [false] ∧ c b = parent ++ [true] ∧
    (∀ i, (c i).length ≤ (c a).length) ∧ (∀ other, prefixCode other → cost c ≤ cost other)
changed.unlocks: Gives a recursive way to build a minimum-cost finite code with tied weights.
changed.context: A fixed-length code gives a finite cost bound, and positive integer weights bound every word length under that cost. Choose a minimizing code, contract unary trie nodes, and take two siblings at maximum depth. Swap designated symbols onto these leaves by exchanges in nondecreasing weight order, never increasing cost. Reorient their parent if necessary. Estimated 120 minutes.

changed.title: Transversal counting bounds how often a fixed-sum vector rule selects a marked position on permutations
changed.statement:
∀ (m h : Nat),
  let K := ZMod 2
  let U := Fin m → K
  let H := Fin h → K
  let I := U × H
  let W := I → I
  let V := I → K
  let b := 2^m
  let s := 2^h
  let n := b*s
  let unit := fun (i j : I) => if j = i then (1 : K) else 0
  let translate := fun (p : Equiv.Perm I) (u : U) (i : I) =>
    ((p i).1 + u, (p i).2)
  ∀ (P : W → V) (A : V),
    (∀ p : Equiv.Perm I, (∑ u : U, P (translate p u)) = A) →
      let cross := (Finset.univ : Finset (Equiv.Perm I)).filter (fun p =>
        ∀ u : U, ((Finset.univ : Finset I).filter (fun i => (p i).1 = u ∧ A i = 1)).card = 1)
      let bad := (Finset.univ : Finset (Equiv.Perm I)).filter (fun p =>
        ∀ i : I, (p i).1 = 0 → P (fun j => p j) ≠ unit i)
      cross.card = (if ((Finset.univ : Finset I).filter (fun i => A i = 1)).card = b
        then s^b * Nat.factorial b * Nat.factorial (n-b) else 0) ∧
        Nat.factorial n ≤ cross.card + b*bad.card
changed.unlocks: Counts the orbits where a fixed sum permits one selected position at every shift.
changed.context: In a shift orbit the zero-prefix positions run through b disjoint blocks partitioning all positions. If every output is a unit at a currently marked position, their binary sum picks exactly one position per block. Every orbit where A fails this test has at least one bad output. Count the transversal permutations by assigning the b marked positions distinct prefixes, then one suffix per marked position, then bijecting the remaining n-b symbols. If the support size differs from b the count is zero.

changed.title: Covering permutations by low-degree vectors forces their prediction set to change under suffix relabelling
changed.statement:
∀ (m h : Nat),
  let K := ZMod 2
  let U := Fin m → K
  let H := Fin h → K
  let I := U × H
  let W := I → I
  let V := I → K
  let J := I × (Fin m ⊕ Fin h)
  let b := 2^m
  let s := 2^h
  let n := b*s
  let bit := fun (x : W) (j : J) => Sum.elim (x j.1).1 (x j.1).2 j.2
  let low := fun (P : W → V) => ∀ i, ∃ T : Finset (Finset J),
    (∀ mon ∈ T, mon.card ≤ m) ∧ ∀ x, P x i = ∑ mon ∈ T, ∏ j ∈ mon, bit x j
  let unit := fun (i j : I) => if j = i then (1 : K) else 0
  let move := fun (p : Equiv.Perm I) (t : H) (i : I) =>
    if (p i).1 = 0 then ((p i).1, (p i).2+t) else p i
  ∀ P : H → W → V, (∀ a, low (P a)) →
    let menu := fun (x : W) => (Finset.univ : Finset H).image (fun a => P a x)
    let missed := (Finset.univ : Finset (Equiv.Perm I)).filter (fun p =>
      unit (p.symm (0,0)) ∉ menu (fun i => p i))
    let changed := (Finset.univ : Finset (Equiv.Perm I × H)).filter (fun v =>
      menu (move v.1 v.2) ≠ menu (fun i => v.1 i))
    let good := s^b * Nat.factorial b * Nat.factorial (n-b)
    s * Nat.factorial n ≤ s*good + b * (s*missed.card + changed.card)
changed.unlocks: Bounds how often a covering polynomial menu must change under suffix relabelling.
changed.context: Each predictor misses every candidate unit on at least (n!-s^b b!(n-b)!)/b permutations, by its fixed prefix-shift sum. On one permutation let t be the number of distinct candidate units in its menu. At most s-t entries miss them all. The s suffix shifts in the named class present each target once. Each target absent from the original menu causes either a joint miss after that shift or a change of the menu. Sum over all bases. Each shift permutes bases, so the joint-miss term is sM. Compare both counts.

changed.title: Errors of a polynomial on the positions of a named symbol class are bounded by its ones outside the class
changed.statement:
∀ (m h : Nat),
  let K := ZMod 2
  let U := Fin m → K
  let H := Fin h → K
  let I := U × H
  let W := I → I
  let V := I → K
  let J := I × (Fin m ⊕ Fin h)
  let bit := fun (x : W) (j : J) => Sum.elim (x j.1).1 (x j.1).2 j.2
  let low := fun (P : W → V) => ∀ i, ∃ T : Finset (Finset J),
    (∀ mon ∈ T, mon.card ≤ m) ∧ ∀ x, P x i = ∑ mon ∈ T, ∏ j ∈ mon, bit x j
  let translate := fun (p : Equiv.Perm I) (u : U) (i : I) =>
    ((p i).1 + u, (p i).2)
  ∀ P : W → V, low P →
    ∃ A : V, (∀ p : Equiv.Perm I, (∑ u : U, P (translate p u)) = A) ∧
      ∀ i : I,
        let onErrors := (Finset.univ : Finset (Equiv.Perm I)).filter (fun p =>
          (p i).1 = 0 ∧ P (fun j => p j) i ≠ A i)
        let outside := (Finset.univ : Finset (Equiv.Perm I)).filter (fun p =>
          (p i).1 ≠ 0 ∧ P (fun j => p j) i ≠ 0)
        onErrors.card ≤ outside.card
changed.unlocks: Charges discrepancies at distinguished positions to positive predictions outside them.
changed.context: Sum over the 2^m common shifts. To survive binary summation a raw monomial must supply every shift variable. Its degree bound leaves no factor for the base input, so the sum is fixed. For each position and translation orbit exactly one shifted permutation gives it zero prefix. Its discrepancy from the fixed bit is the parity of all other values at that position in the orbit. A discrepancy costs at least one outside one. Sum the count over disjoint orbits.

changed.title: When polynomial predictions are supported on a named class, exact coverage is equivalent to isolation by subsets
changed.statement:
∀ (m h : Nat),
  let K := ZMod 2
  let U := Fin m → K
  let H := Fin h → K
  let I := U × H
  let W := I → I
  let V := I → K
  let J := I × (Fin m ⊕ Fin h)
  let s := 2^h
  let n := 2^m*s
  let bit := fun (x : W) (j : J) => Sum.elim (x j.1).1 (x j.1).2 j.2
  let low := fun (P : W → V) => ∀ i, ∃ T : Finset (Finset J),
    (∀ mon ∈ T, mon.card ≤ m) ∧ ∀ x, P x i = ∑ mon ∈ T, ∏ j ∈ mon, bit x j
  let unit := fun (i j : I) => if j = i then (1 : K) else 0
  let fails := fun (k : Nat) (A : Fin k → Finset I) =>
    (Finset.univ : Finset (I × Finset I)).filter (fun v =>
      v.1 ∈ v.2 ∧ v.2.card = s ∧ ∀ a, A a ∩ v.2 ≠ {v.1})
  ∀ k : Nat,
    let miss := fun (P : Fin k → W → V) =>
      (Finset.univ : Finset (Equiv.Perm I)).filter (fun p =>
        ∀ a, P a (fun i => p i) ≠ unit (p.symm (0,0)))
    let outside := fun (P : Fin k → W → V) =>
      ∑ a : Fin k, ∑ p : Equiv.Perm I,
        ((Finset.univ : Finset I).filter (fun i => (p i).1 ≠ 0 ∧ P a (fun j => p j) i ≠ 0)).card
    (∀ P, (∀ a, low (P a)) → ∃ A : Fin k → Finset I,
      Nat.factorial (s-1) * Nat.factorial (n-s) * (fails k A).card ≤
        (miss P).card + outside P) ∧
    ((∃ P, (∀ a, low (P a)) ∧ (miss P).card = 0 ∧ outside P = 0) ↔
      ∃ A : Fin k → Finset I, (fails k A).card = 0)
changed.unlocks: Characterizes supported polynomial repair lists by a point-isolating family of subsets.
changed.context: Use the fixed translation-sum mask of each predictor. Every bad mask configuration (i,S) has (s-1)!(n-s)! permutations. Conversely realize each isolating mask by multiplying its coordinate bits by the indicator of zero prefix there. This indicator is a product of m affine bits.

changed.statement:
¬ (let nonlinear := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>
  (g.inputs.length == 2) &&

      (xor (g.op.eval [true, false]) (g.op.eval [true, true]))
let depth := fun (w : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
  (C.gates.foldl (fun (ds : List ℕ) g =>
    ds ++ [(g.inputs.map (fun a => ds.getD a 0)).foldr max 0 + (nonlinear g).toNat])
    (List.replicate w 0)).getD C.output 0
∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
  (∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack 32 C ∧
  PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun u v : Fin 16 => decide (u = v)) C ∧
  depth 32 C ≤ 2 ∧ C.gates.countP nonlinear ≤ 2)
